        :figure grass

        :rcc TPP
        :directional below
        :viewer cam)
    :depicts (sf3 / SpatialFact
        :figure branches
        :ground person
        :rcc TPP
        :directional behind
        :viewer cam)
    :depicts (sf4 / SpatialFact
        :figure trees
        :ground person
        :rcc TPP
        :directional behind
        :viewer cam))
